tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sa lo chen po'i gsung 'bum gyi dkar chag bzhugs so// 001 gsan yig thos pa'i rgya mtsho rin po che pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba la/ 002 gsan yig skabs dang po/ rje btsun dam pa rdo rje 'chang rat+na war+dha'i zhal las sdom pa gsum sogs nye bar nos pa'i skabs dang po'o// 003 gsan yig skabs gnyis pa/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbang ma ho pā dh+yā ya bsod nams legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan las rdo rje theg pa sogs nye bar nos pa'i skabs gnyis pa'o// 004 gsan yig skabs gsum pa/ rje btsun rnal 'byor dbang phyug sems dpa' chen po bud+dha rat+na shrī bha dra'i zhal las rdo rje theg pa sogs nye bar nos pa'i skabs gsum pa'o// 005 gsan yig skabs bzhi pa/ rgyal ba 'dren pa 'chi med dbang po sogs nye bar nos pa'i skabs bzhi pa'o// 006 gsan yig skabs lnga pa/ thun mong ma yin pa yongs su rdzogs pa nye bar nos pa'i skabs lnga pa'o// 007 gsan yig skabs drug pa/ bran bdud nag po'i rjes gnang la sogs nye bar nos pa'i skabs drug pa'o// 008 gsan yig skabs bdun pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo sogs nang gi zab don mchog rnams thos tshul smros pa'i skabs bdun pa'o// 009 mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub kyi rnam thar blo gsal klu'i dbang po'i gtsug gi nor bu zhes pa/ 010 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi rnam thar dge legs rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba dang / 011 de'i kha skong ut+pala'i chun po/ 012 bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa byin rlabs kyi chu gter zhes bya ba/ 013 yang bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang mchod pa'i cho ga bsdus pa dang / 014 byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor ut+pa la dkar po'i cod paṇa zhes bya spyan ras gzigs la sbyar ba lha cig sangs rgyas skyabs ma la gnang ba/ 015 sbyor ba yan lag drug gi lam rim gyi sgo nas bla ma'i gsol 'debs/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams la bstod pa thugs rje'i char 'bebs/

rtsa ba'i bla ma yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhyen chen bsod nams lhun grub/ lo chen chos skyong bzang po rnams la bstod pa re/ rje rang gi bdag bstod/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis dang / rje nyid rang la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa nus ldan dbang po shrī de wi'i don du mdzad pa/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen dang / zha lu lo chen gnyis kyi bstod pa/ rje rang gi bdag bstod rnams skad gnyis/ lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ spros med brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ sbyor drug brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ de'i gsham na rin chen rgyal mchog zhabs la gsol ba 'debs zer ba'i sh+lau ka gcig dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i lam zab rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig ngo sprod dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rnal 'byor pa rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i nyis 'bigs/ kun rig brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ mi 'khrugs brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rdo rje phur pa'i stod las kyi dbang gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ smad las drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kha skong / yang rdo rje phur pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bsdus pa/ bde mchog bla brgyud kyi gsol 'debs kha skong / snar thang dpe khang gi bsrung ma spe hwa rang la phrin bcol sh+lau ka gnyis/ rta mgrin yang gsang bla brgyud kyi gsol 'debs/ gu ru drag dmar gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ bla ma dam pa la shugs ring dad pa'i rgyang 'bod thugs rje'i chu skyes zhes bya ba gcen la dbon po shes rab rgyal mtshan la gnang ba/ 016 yon tan rgya mtsho ma'i tshig don gyi dogs chod ma rig mun sel/ 017 rgya nag rgyal po la phul ba'i zhu yig mnga' ris rdzong khar mnga' bdag rgyal po la gnang ba/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub la phul ba'i zhu yig nyis 'bigs gcig dang bzhi/

zha lu lo chen la phul ba'i zhu yig e wam̐ chos ldan gyi 'bul sdud pa dge 'dun dpal bzang la gdams pa/ yig mkhan zla grags la gnang ba'i bka' shog gnyis/ lo dgon pa'i spyan snga la gnang ba'i bka' shog sdeb sbyor med pa gcig dang / yod pa gnyis te gsum/ bla ma sgra tshad pa dkon mchog rgya mtsho la gnang ba'i bka' shog byang pa chos rje rin chen bzang po la gnang ba'i bka' shog gnyis/ thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi mkhan po chos rje blo gros rab yangs pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog rab 'byams pa kun tshe la gnang ba'i bka' shog smin drug lo tsā la gnang ba'i bka' shog gdong dga' ba kun spangs tshe ring grags pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog lhun rtse mkhan po thams cad mkhyen pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog 'dol kha rgyal po la gnang ba'i bka' shog rgyal mkhar rtser gnang ba'i bka' shog gnyis/ 018 seng ge rtse pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog dge legs kyi tshigs su bka' dam gcig dang bzhi/ gzhis kha rin spungs pa dpon blon sogs la gnang ba'i bka' shog dgu dang / snar thang pas rtsom grogs zhus pa gcig tshong 'dus pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog gnas gsar ba la gnang ba'i bka' shog gnas pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog gnyis/ rtsed pa nam mkha' la gnang ba'i bka' shog rin chen rtse ba'i gnyer pa dkyil mkhar seng sding pa la gnang ba'i dris lan bka' shog khams kyi 'bul sdud pa bla ma sgra tshad pa dkon mchog rgya mtsho dge slong nam mkha' rtse mo rta 'bul mdo sngags rab 'byams pa kun dga' dpal 'byor rnams la gnang ba'i lam yig sde tshan gsum/ yig mkhan zla grags la gnang ba'i gdam pa/ mkhar spe rab 'byams pa blo gros rab gsal gyi dris lan gnyis/ rab 'byams pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan la gnang ba'i gdam pa/ gdong dga' ba kun spangs chos la bskul ba'i gtam/ byas 'gyur pa'i sgrub chen rnams la dge sbyor bskul 'debs/ snar thang stong dpon dpon blon la gdam pa gnyis/ rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi snang tshul rtsom 'phro gcig

rje nyid rang gi thugs dam smon lam tshigs bcad ma/ dbu rtse rnying ma dang sgo rum gyi rten gsum rnams kyi dkar chag tshigs bcad gnyis/ tshe lha dang nor lha'i tshigs bcad sh+lau ka gnyis/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba'i drung du rje nyid kyi snam sbyar phul ba'i kha yig gser khang na bzhugs yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su/ rje nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i bla ma rin 'byung gi snyan dar kha yig rje sangs rgyas rin chen gyi nang rten gling kha na bzhugs pa'i thub pa'i snyan dar kha yig sgo rum dang / nang so'i dgon khang du/ gzhis rin spungs nas gtor gsos gnang skabs kyi snyan dar kha yig le tshan dgu/ rtsed pa nam mkhas chos skyong thun mong du phul ba'i snyan dar kha yig gcig bsrubs na bzhugs yod/ chos rje dkon mchog tshul khrims pa'i gdung rten rgyal rtse na bzhugs pa'i dngul gyi mchod rten la mngags pa bkra shis kyi mgrin dbyangs zhes pa gcig dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la bstod pa/ gur mgon la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig dmar po skor gsum la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig mnga' ris rgyal po la gnang ba'i bstod pa/ rje nyid kyi bu slob sogs dad gso'i bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa la/ byang pa bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis pa la bstod pa/ gug ge gzhi sde pa nam mkha' brtan pa la bstod pa/ dpal 'khor bde chen gyi mkhan po dkon mchog tshul khrims la bstod pa/ lo dgon pa'i spyan snga la bstod pa/ blo gros rab gsal la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig chos rje mgon po dbang phyug la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi gdan sa pa bkra shis brtan pa la bstod pa/ chos rje dpal ldan rgyal mtshan la bstod pa/ thub bstan yangs pa can gyi gdan sa pa grags pa mtshan la bstod pa/ skye tsa mkhan po rdor 'dzin la bstod pa/ gting skyes pa chos rje kun dga' bkra shis la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig

chos rje rdo rje seng ge la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig nyag ro gser mdog pa'i bla ma la bstod pa/ jo nang mkhan po dpal ldan rin chen la bstod pa/ chos rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig chos rje kun dga' rgya mtsho la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig yang jo nang mkhan po la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig sgrub pa sangs rgyas dpal la bstod pa/ sgrub thabs skor la bla ma rin chen 'byung gi sgrub thabs/ bir bsrung thun mong ma yin pa'i bsgom tshul/ 019 dpal 'khor lo sde mchog nag po pa'i sgrub thabs nges don zla ba'i 'od zer/ 020 sngags phreng phyag bris ma la zhal bshus/ 021 rnal 'byor ma'i rgyun gyi nyams len/ 022 dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs grol ba'i thig le/ rdo rje bdag med ma'i lus dkyil zur 'debs/ yang dag me gcig gi sgrub thabs nor bu'i phreng ba/ 023 dpal rdo rje'i gzhon nu'i khro bo'i sgrub thabs/ 024 dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bdud rtsi'i 'od can/ 025 gu ru drag dmar gyi sgrub thabs/ 026 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ 027 bsrung ma drug cu'i gtor chog 028 gshed dmar dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs/ spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ 029 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ 030 de'i rjes gnang byed tshul/ 031 mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs/ phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed/ seng gdong ma/ spyan ras gzigs rnams kyi sgrub thabs chung ngu gsum/ rjes gnang gi tho gnyis mchan du yod pa/ tshe dpag med grub pa'i rgyal mo'i sgrub thabs/ tshe dpag med dze tā ri lha dgu'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho lha gcig sangs rgyas skyabs ma la gnang ba/ rdo rje rnal 'joms kyi sgrub thabs/ 'chi med sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ dpal gur gyi mgon po'i khro bcu'i bsrung 'khor khams gsum bdud las rnam rgyal/

032 mgon po dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs bdud 'joms rdo rje rnams so// nyer mkho la rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg sa skya pa'i dkar gtor cha bzhi gtong tshul gsung rgyun ma/ gtor chen zur 'debs/ 033 rnam rgyal stong mchod kyi chog sgrigs 'chi med dpal gter/ khro bo rme brtsegs kyi bstod pa grib sel kun grol/ 034 myur rtsis rnam dag skyon med nyer mkho kun gsal/ 035 'khor lo bde mchog gi 'chad thabs/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi sa bcad rtsom 'phro/ rdo rje phreng ba'i zin bris/ 036 gnas yul rtsa khams kyi dbye ba/ 037 zhal gnyis pa'i byin rlabs byed tshul/ 038 dbang bshad mdor bsdus/ smon lam sh+lau ka gcig 039 mgon po lha lnga'i dbang bshad/ 040 byang pa bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis pa che 'don mdzad dus gnang ba'i mo gtam dgos pa skabs don/ rtse gdong pa'i dger gyi gdung rabs/ bsngo ba gcig 041 rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi dbang gi brgyud pa la nang mchod 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad/ nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa'i bstod pa phreng 'dzin chos kyi nyin byed kyis mdzad pa la 'gyur gnang ba'i skad gnyis/ 042 bde mchog dkar po'i khrid yig zur 'debs gsal ba'i sgron me/ 043 gshed dmar gyi khrid yig gsal byed nges don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi them skas/ 044 ku ru kul+le'i rdzogs rim ut+pa la'i lcags kyu/ 045 rdo rje phur pa'i 'chams bshad/ 046 rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i gsal byed rin po che'i do shal/ 047 sbyin sreg rdo rje'i me 'od/ 048 gtor bzlog dgra bgegs kun 'joms kyi lhan thabs gsal byed gnam lcags rdo rje'i dbal/ 049 ma hā kā la'i gtor chog phrin las lhun grub/ ma hā kā la'i gtor chog bdud las rnam rgyal/ 050 dpal sa skya pa'i bka' bsrung rnams kyi gtor chog rgyun gyi nyams len klag pas grub pa/

dpal sa skya pa'i yi dam chos skyong rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba'i tho snar thang dpon mo la gnang ba/ 051 rdo rje nag po chen po'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 052 dpal sa skya pa'i bka' bsrung rnams kyi bskang gso mnyes byed 'chi med sgra dbyangs/ 053 dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i bskang gso dngos grub rol mtsho/ 054 dpal mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la bstod pa dgra bgegs srog gcod kyi 'khor lo/ 055 dpal sa skya pa'i chos skyong rdo rje gur gyi mgon po'i las tshogs gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag drug cu pa'i cho ga dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu gri/ 056 chos kyi rgyal po lha bcu gsum gyi bskyed chog 057 dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi gtor chog 058 rdo rje phur pa'i bsrung ma dkar bdud lcam dral dang dam can gyi gtor chog dngos grub bsam 'phel rnams bzhugs so// bzhengs byed kho bo dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /dbang gi mtshan gsol grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ /bka' gnang lhur bslangs tshe ring rnam rgyal yin/ /dge bas mar gyur 'gro drug sems can rnams/ /rnam mkhyen byang chub lam la 'dren pa dang / /dpal ldan bla mas rjes su 'dzin par shog /maṅga laṃ/ e waṃ// //
